title: Dual-Loop Supervised Project Profile
description: Project-owned settings frozen into each supervised round so the controller never hardcodes repository paths or ports.

protected_paths.description: Repository-relative paths the executor must never modify. Trailing slash denotes a directory prefix.

require_clean_worktree.description: If true, refuse issue/recycle when the repository has uncommitted changes.

docs.description: Repository-relative entry documents for project rules.
